rules.d_drive_usage: cold evidence mirrors and LIGHT backups only
rules.worktree_and_temp_db_cleanup: task-by-task only after evidence is durably hashed

baseline_recorded_phase0.note: Phase 0 records the baseline only; no maintenance is performed.

maintenance_policy: No maintenance in Phase 0. Any conditional maintenance in a later phase requires separate authorization and follows the M16 S3 pattern (frozen inventory, explicit allow-list, one volume at a time, never a prune).
